summary: Pure Evil HERO and Dark Fusion build led by the 2025 Supreme Darkness wave, paired with generic staples. Evil HERO Dead-End Prison substitutes for any named Fusion Material, letting the deck summon Evil HERO Inferno Wing - Backfire alongside Evil HERO Malicious Bane without running vanilla Elemental HERO bricks.

summary.title: Starters
points: Evil HERO Infernal Rider searches Dark Fusion (or any card that mentions it) on Normal or Special Summon, and banishes 4 monsters from your GY to Set Super Polymerization directly from the Deck.
Evil HERO Adusted Gold discards itself from the hand to search Dark Calling, Evil Assault, or any card that mentions Dark Fusion.

Evil Assault discards 1 card to add a Level 4 or lower Evil HERO to your hand or Special Summon it directly from the Deck, while Evil HERO Sinister Necrom banishes itself from the GY to summon an Evil HERO from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Evil Assault (or Adusted Gold)
steps: Activate Evil Assault, discarding a card (ideally Evil HERO Sinister Necrom) to Special Summon Evil HERO Infernal Rider from the Deck and search Dark Fusion.
Banish Sinister Necrom from the GY to Special Summon Evil HERO Dead-End Prison from the Deck, which sends a HERO to the GY to become a substitute for any named Fusion Material.
Activate Dark Fusion (or Dark Calling) to Fusion Summon Evil HERO Inferno Wing - Backfire using Dead-End Prison, searching Dark Supremacy or Supreme King's Castle on Summon.
Special Summon Evil HERO Toxic Bubble to draw 2 cards while you control a Dark Fusion monster, then use Dark Calling or Dark Contact to summon Evil HERO Malicious Bane.

summary.title: Dark Fusion & Material Substitution
summary.text: Old Evil HERO Fusions require specific Elemental HERO Normal Monsters and must be Special Summoned with Dark Fusion. Supreme King's Castle removes the Dark Fusion restriction so any Fusion effect can summon them, while Evil HERO Dead-End Prison Special Summons itself next to a Dark Fusion monster and substitutes for a named material—unlocking Evil HERO Inferno Wing - Backfire and serving as the Rock material for Evil HERO Dark Gaia. Xtra HERO Infernal Devicer can also reveal a HERO Fusion in the Extra Deck to search its named materials.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Evil HERO Malicious Bane (Evil HERO + Level 5+ monster) cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects and destroys all opponent's monsters with ATK less than or equal to its own while gaining 200 ATK per destroyed monster.
Evil HERO Inferno Wing - Backfire searches a Dark Fusion card on Summon and inflicts 2100 burn damage whenever any HERO you control destroys a monster.

Evil HERO Darkest Knight (Fiend + Warrior) reduces all opposing monsters' ATK by the original ATK of a Fusion Material in your GY and can attack twice each Battle Phase, while Evil HERO Malicious Fiend forces all opponent's monsters to attack it.
Destiny HERO - Destroyer Phoenix Enforcer and Masked HERO Dark Law provide supplementary HERO Fusion disruption.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Dark Fusion Fusion Summons a Fiend Fusion Monster and grants it targeting immunity from the opponent's cards and effects for the turn.

Dark Calling banishes materials from the hand or GY, while Dark Contact shuffles materials from your GY or banishment back into the Deck to Fusion Summon (or searches Supreme King's Castle / Dark Fusion).

Dark Supremacy banishes itself or activates on the field to negate face-up cards the opponent controls up to the number of Dark Fusion Spells in your GY, and Super Polymerization (Set from the Deck by Infernal Rider) fuses away opposing threats.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Vanilla Elemental HERO Normal Monsters (Avian, Burstinatrix, Sparkman, Clayman) and the legacy Evil HERO Fusions that require two specific names are omitted in favor of the self-contained Evil HERO engine.
